name: data-safety-check
description: Check the Data safety answers kept in an Android app repository against the app: the permissions in every AndroidManifest.xml and the well-known SDKs in the Gradle files, mapped to the Data safety data types of Google Play. Reports data types the answers leave out, declared data without a purpose, and names Google does not list. Reads files only; never runs Gradle or a build, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
